title: Turkish University Admissions Analysis
text:
This project presents an exploratory data analysis of Turkish university admissions between 2019 and 2024.
The study investigates:

Admission scores
Admission rankings
University types
Score categories
Gender distributions
Preference behaviors
Quota utilization trends

The analysis was conducted using R and Quarto based on publicly available higher education admission data.

title: Data
text:
Dataset Source
The dataset used in this project contains Turkish university admission statistics between 2019 and 2024.
Source: https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/ramazanizci/turkish-university-admissions


Dataset Description
The dataset includes:

Admission scores
Admission rankings
University types
Score types
Preference statistics
Gender distributions
Quota information



Data Preparation
Before analysis, the dataset was cleaned and prepared in R.
The following preprocessing steps were applied:

Missing values were removed
Irrelevant variables were excluded
Summary statistics were generated
Data was grouped by year and category
Variables were standardized where necessary

Why We Used R
R is useful for:

Data cleaning
Statistical analysis
Aggregation
Data visualization

It is widely used in exploratory data analysis projects.



Project Limitations

The dataset contains aggregated admission data.
Individual student behavior cannot be analyzed directly.
The project focuses on trends and associations, not causation.
